mapper.select: SELECT b.benefit_id, b.benefit_name, b.benefit_kind, b.calc_method, b.benefit_value, b.target_type, b.target_category_id, b.target_merchant_id, b.require_performance, b.require_payment_type, b.min_txn_amount, b.max_eligible_amount, b.max_benefit_per_txn, b.monthly_limit, b.limit_group_code, b.monthly_count_limit, b.daily_count_limit, b.daily_limit, b.quarterly_limit, b.yearly_limit, b.quarterly_count_limit, b.yearly_count_limit, b.count_group_code, b.step_count, b.performance_period, b.exclude_from_performance, b.option_group_code, b.option_key, b.use_shared_limit, tl.tier_monthly_limit, tl.tier_quarterly_limit, tl.tier_yearly_limit, tl.tier_benefit_value FROM benefit b LEFT JOIN benefit_tier_limit tl ON tl.benefit_id = b.benefit_id AND tl.tier_id = CASE WHEN b.performance_period = 'QUARTER' THEN #{quarterTierId} ELSE #{monthTierId} END WHERE b.card_id = #{cardId} AND b.is_active = 'Y' AND b.benefit_kind NOT IN ('GIFT', 'INSTALLMENT_FREE', 'RETROACTIVE') ORDER BY b.benefit_id

SELECT x.benefit_id, x.exclusion_type, x.exclusion_value FROM benefit_exclusion x JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = x.benefit_id WHERE b.card_id = #{cardId} AND b.is_active = 'Y' AND b.benefit_kind NOT IN ('GIFT', 'INSTALLMENT_FREE', 'RETROACTIVE')

SELECT DISTINCT b.option_group_code AS optionGroupCode, b.option_key AS optionKey FROM benefit b WHERE b.card_id = #{cardId} AND b.is_active = 'Y' AND b.option_group_code IS NOT NULL AND b.option_key IS NOT NULL AND b.benefit_kind NOT IN ('GIFT', 'INSTALLMENT_FREE', 'RETROACTIVE') ORDER BY b.option_group_code, b.option_key
